basics.name: Aritrika Karmakar
basics.label: Business Development Representative (BDR) · CRM & Outbound Pipeline · HubSpot · Salesforce · LinkedIn Sales Navigator · 2+ Years

summaries.default: Accomplished Business Development Representative with 2+ years of experience and expertise in CRM management, lead qualification, outbound prospecting, and campaign execution. Achieved a 45% increase in audience engagement through data-driven lead-nurturing campaigns at Inmisceo, managing CRM outreach across a 100,000+ contact database.

work.name: Inmisceo
work.domainNote: Technology/training company building learning-technology tools for corporate training providers.
highlights: Supported lead generation initiatives through multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, LinkedIn, website and industry events, contributing to pipeline growth and customer acquisition.
Collaborated closely with sales and leadership teams to qualify marketing-generated leads, coordinate follow-up activities and support product demos and webinars.
Managed CRM activities in HubSpot, maintaining audience segmentation, automated workflows and accurate customer records across a 100,000+ contact database.
Optimised lead nurturing pathways using open, click-through, and conversion rate analytics, resulting in a 45% increase in audience engagement.
Led CRM platform selection and setup, enabling scalable marketing automation and GDPR-compliant data structures from the ground up.
Ensured campaign QA, UTM tracking accuracy, and delivered monthly CRM campaigns to 100K+ contacts with high QA standards and GDPR compliance.
